extension.summary: Declencheur du Mode Ambiant Akasha OS
extension.description: Surveille l'inactivite (xbmc.getGlobalIdleTime) et declenche script.akasha.ambient au bout du delai configure, tant qu'aucune lecture video/audio n'est en cours.
Watches idle time (xbmc.getGlobalIdleTime) and triggers script.akasha.ambient after the configured delay, as long as no video/audio is playing.
